concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Edit the supplied image as a concept refinement for the company brand 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO. Keep the identity presentation pure BLACK AND WHITE, flat vector-like shapes on white, crisp edges, no gradients, no texture, no shadows or 3D. The user's new requirement is to make the culture “善心、善念、善行” shape the logo design itself. Do not merely add the slogan beneath the unchanged logo. Make intentional, visible refinements to the mark, while keeping its original design family and correct Chinese spelling. The design must work in one color at small sizes. Use an airy professional landscape presentation: upper-left concept title; large refined main identity in the central 60%; a modest small-scale same mark and reverse-color same mark along lower left; three concise explanatory callouts along lower right. The explanations are presentation annotations, not part of the logo. Exact three annotation labels are “善心”, “善念”, “善行”, each followed by at most four Chinese characters. No extra advertising text or full company name. Show exactly ONE coherent refined concept, with identical shapes in every size and reverse test. DIRECTION A, title “A / 礼林字标”. Preserve the elegant bespoke literary Chinese horizontal wordmark approach. Redraw 礼林 to be calmer, slightly less sweeping and more optically balanced than the reference. Culture must have these three clear design features: 善心: generous breathing space and softly cupped inner curve of 礼, communicating care; 善念: 礼's horizontal finishing stroke meets the base rhythm of 林 with a subtle intelligent join, suggesting considered continuity; 善行: 林's final right downstroke extends gently forward and lands firmly, expressing action without an arrow. Keep every Chinese character clearly legible; 生态 remains restrained smaller lettering and LILIN ECO beneath. The visible upper portion of 礼 must retain a correct 礻 component, not become 衤. No separate emblem, hearts, hand icons, literal trees, circles or enclosing square. Three short explanatory phrases exactly: “善心 · 留白包容”, “善念 · 笔画相承”, “善行 · 舒展落笔”. Draw small hairline leader lines or miniature enlarged stroke details beside those explanatory labels so one can see which stroke carries the idea, without cluttering the main logo. The emotional effect should be warm restraint, not ornate calligraphy.
